about: AGGREGATE (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 16; ADR-0047, 2026-10-10): admitted while a Sheet cannot hide a row, so options 1, 3, 5 and 7 give what 0, 2, 4 and 6 give. Options 0 to 3 pass over a cell whose whole Formula is a SUBTOTAL or an AGGREGATE; any other call of either in the range is #VALUE! until a Windows run asks Excel. Function numbers for functions the engine does not support (13, 16-19) are #VALUE!.
